propositions: Non-exempt tickets receiving a non-degraded PASS verdict through public plan-review entry points must sign and persist a plan-review attestation by default without explicit caller opt-in
Skipping attestation signature on a PASS verdict requires explicit opt-out: --no-sign flag for CLI usage and sign=False parameter for library usage
BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, and local-source results must remain unsigned regardless of caller intent; signing guards are enforced at the attest.sign_plan_review boundary
Re-running a default plan-review operation with a current claim-valid attestation must reuse it idempotently without an LLM call or duplicate signature event
A PASS verdict with attempted signature-persistence failure must return an established retryable nonzero disposition identifying sign-review as the recovery path
MCP review_plan tool is explicitly out of scope; sign opt-out and readonly unsigned reasons are delegated to a separate public-contract change
